segments.name: High Performance Materials & Components
segments.description: Makes high-performance alloys and components for aerospace, defence and energy customers.
segments.evidence: We operate in two business segments: High Performance Materials & Components (HPMC) and Advanced Alloys & Solutions (AA&S).

segments.name: Advanced Alloys & Solutions
segments.description: Produces flat rolled and specialty alloy products for energy, medical and electronics markets.
segments.evidence: The major end markets for our flat rolled products are aerospace & defense, specialty and conventional energy, automotive, medical and electronics markets.

revenueModel.text: Aerospace, defence, energy and medical customers buy its specialty alloys and components.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold to a variety of end customers in the end-use energy market, with a focus on specialty energy, which includes nuclear power generation and gas turbines.
